mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion (merchant_id, name, type, description, start_time, end_time, min_amount, reduce_amount, discount_rate, free_shipping_threshold, status, is_recommend, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{description}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{minAmount}, #{reduceAmount}, #{discountRate}, #{freeShippingThreshold}, #{status}, #{isRecommend}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, description = #{description}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, min_amount = #{minAmount}, reduce_amount = #{reduceAmount}, discount_rate = #{discountRate}, free_shipping_threshold = #{freeShippingThreshold}, status = #{status}, is_recommend = #{isRecommend}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM promotion WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM promotion WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
